newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 7.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 7.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The man, accused with the explosion in a house in Ugocsa street, denied the allegations.
- The Finance Ministry said that the Hungarian economy was not yet in balance last yearj, but once the economic growth kicks off, the situation may improve.
- The Welfare Ministry has begun to work out proposals concerning old-age benefits.
- The Hungarian Chamber of Doctors believe that sources will not be sufficient for an 18 percent pay rise of healthcare employees.
- Hungary has extended the mandate of Hungarian military and police units serving in the Sinai-peninsula by four years at the request of international peacekeeping forces.
